items.title: Amos White Interview, 1958-08-23
items.q: I serenaded Harry Truman over there, his regiment, Captain Harry Truman.

ctx.x: Well, then began the history of the 816th Band. Well, the history of the 816th Band measures up very creditably. In that while we were stationed in Verdun, every afternoon except Saturday and Sundays, we had to play a concert in Chevert Square in Verdun. Aside from other planes that we did around in various camps, I serenaded Harry Truman over there, his regiment, Captain Harry Truman. But I didn't know it was Captain Harry Truman. I knew it was Captain Harry Truman there, but I heard no more about him until he…
